'''Laszlo Pusztai''' (also published as '''Laszlo Pasztai''') was a Decipher-era [[Squadron Members|Squadron Member]], listed as Red 103 from Budapest, Hun. The published fan table marks the slot Retired after Decipher's SWCCG run. He played at the [[2001 European Championship]] on 26 August 2001 with [[Watch Your Step / This Place Can Be A Little Rough|WYS]], according to Bastian Winkelhaus's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2911">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-09-01-european-championships-paris-last-weekd2911/ european-championships-paris-last-week], DeckTech (Bastian "Death Star" Winkelhaus, 1 September 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-09-01-european-championships-paris-last-weekd2911/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

Decipher recruited volunteer Squadron Members in the 1990s to promote SWCCG locally (tournaments, demos, player support). "FL" is printed on some slots in the surviving tables; the tables do not spell out the abbreviation.
